definitionZh: 使用“window.fetch()”异步请求包含的文件。请求会被缓存，因此可以多次包含同一文件，但只会发出一次请求。
sourceDefinition: Included files are asynchronously requested using `window.fetch()`. Requests are cached, so the same file can be included multiple times, but only one request will be made.
